2) ACH authorization OR bank letter + voided check for verification (template attached).
3) Remit-to name and exact mailing address for final invoices.

Next steps: can you complete the attached PDF and return with ACH/bank proof by EOD Friday 11/20? If not, let me know the earliest you can send.

Hi Samantha — Marissa from Redwood Finance here. Quick checklist from finance to complete vendor activation: 

1) Formal ACH Authorization or bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account ownership (scanned PDF).
2) Voided check OR bank proof showing full account number (we use this to validate with our payment processor).
3) Completed W-9 (we have it — thank you).
4) Confirmation of tax classification (C-Corp, S-Corp, etc.) on the intake form (looks like you marked "Corporation" — confirm).

Once we receive 1+2 we'll run a micro-deposit validation (same-day/1-day process) and then we can approve the vendor for PO payments via ACH. If you prefer wire for the first payment, include wire instructions and SWIFT (if outside US) and note that wires require manual approval and longer processing.

If any of that is sensitive, please upload secure documents via the DocuSign link I sent below and then reply with the DocuSign transaction id.

Thanks — I will start the vendor verification once the bank letter/voided check arrives.

Marissa Cole
